verses.en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: Ainda veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.pt: Filho do homem, faze conhecer a Jerusalém seus atos abomináveis;
verses.en_web: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, make clear to Jerusalem her disgusting ways,

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
verses.pt: e dize: Assim diz o Senhor Deus a Jerusalém: A tua origem e o teu nascimento procedem da terra dos cananeus. Teu pai era amorreu, e a tua mãe hetéia.
verses.en_web: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.
verses.en_bbe: And say, This is what the Lord has said to Jerusalem: Your start and your birth was from the land of the Canaanite; an Amorite was your father and your mother was a Hittite.

verses.en: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.pt: E, quanto ao teu nascimento, no dia em que nasceste não te foi cortado o umbigo, nem foste lavada com água, para te alimpar; nem tampouco foste esfregada com sal, nem envolta em faixas;
verses.en_web: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.en_bbe: As for your birth, on the day of your birth your cord was not cut and you were not washed in water to make you clean; you were not salted or folded in linen bands.

verses.en: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.pt: ninguém se apiedou de ti para te fazer alguma destas coisas, compadecido de ti; porém foste lançada fora no campo, pelo nojo de ti, no dia em que nasceste.
verses.en_web: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
verses.en_bbe: No eye had pity on you to do any of these things to you or to be kind to you; but you were put out into the open country, because your life was hated at the time of your birth.

verses.en: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
verses.pt: E, passando eu por ti, vi-te banhada no teu sangue, e disse- te: Ainda que estás no teu sangue, vive; sim, disse-te: Ainda que estás no teu sangue, vive.
verses.en_web: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’
verses.en_bbe: And when I went past you and saw you stretched out in your blood, I said to you, Though you are stretched out in your blood, have life;

verses.en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.
verses.pt: Eu te fiz multiplicar como o renovo do campo. E cresceste, e te engrandeceste, e alcançaste grande formosura. Formaram-se os teus seios e cresceu o teu cabelo; contudo estavas nua e descoberta.
verses.en_web: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent ornament. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.
verses.en_bbe: And be increased in number like the buds of the field; and you were increased and became great, and you came to the time of love: your breasts were formed and your hair was long; but you were uncovered and without clothing.

verses.en: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
verses.pt: Então, passando eu por ti, vi-te, e eis que o teu tempo era tempo de amores; e estendi sobre ti a minha aba, e cobri a tua nudez; e dei-te juramento, e entrei num pacto contigo, diz o Senhor Deus, e tu ficaste sendo minha.
verses.en_web: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over you, and covered your nakedness. Yes, I swore to you, and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and you became mine.
verses.en_bbe: Now when I went past you, looking at you, I saw that your time was the time of love; and I put my skirts over you, covering your unclothed body: and I gave you my oath and made an agreement with you, says the Lord, and you became mine.

verses.en: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.pt: Então te lavei com água, alimpei-te do teu sangue e te ungi com óleo.
verses.en_web: “‘“Then washed I you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
verses.en_bbe: Then I had you washed with water, washing away all your blood and rubbing you with oil.

verses.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
verses.pt: Também te vesti de bordados, e te calcei com pele de dugongo, cingi-te de linho fino, e te cobri de seda.
verses.en_web: I clothed you also with embroidered work, and put sealskin shoes on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
verses.en_bbe: And I had you clothed with needlework, and put leather shoes on your feet, folding fair linen about you and covering you with silk.

verses.en: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.pt: Também te ornei de enfeites, e te pus braceletes nas mãos e um colar ao pescoço.
verses.en_web: I decked you with ornaments. put bracelets on your hands, and a chain on your neck.
verses.en_bbe: And I made you fair with ornaments and put jewels on your hands and a chain on your neck.

verses.en: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
verses.pt: E te pus um pendente no nariz, e arrecadas nas orelhas, e uma linda coroa na cabeça.
verses.en_web: I put a ring on your nose, and earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
verses.en_bbe: And I put a ring in your nose and ear-rings in your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.

verses.en: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
verses.pt: Assim foste ornada de ouro e prata, e o teu vestido foi de linho fino, de seda e de bordados; de flor de farinha te nutriste, e de mel e azeite; e chegaste a ser formosa em extremo, e subiste até a realeza.
verses.en_web: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
verses.en_bbe: So you were made beautiful with gold and silver; and your clothing was of the best linen and silk and needlework; your food was the best meal and honey and oil: and you were very beautiful.

verses.en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: Correu a tua fama entre as nações, por causa da tua formosura, pois era perfeita, graças ao esplendor que eu tinha posto sobre ti, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: You were so beautiful that the story of you went out into all nations; you were completely beautiful because of my glory which I had put on you, says the Lord.

verses.en: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.pt: Mas confiaste na tua formosura, e te corrompeste por causa da tua fama; e derramavas as tuas prostituições sobre todo o que passava, para seres dele.
verses.en_web: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.
verses.en_bbe: But you put your faith in the fact that you were beautiful, acting like a loose woman because you were widely talked of, and offering your cheap love to everyone who went by, whoever it might be.

verses.en: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
verses.pt: E tomaste dos teus vestidos e fizeste lugares altos adornados de diversas cores, e te prostituíste sobre eles, como nunca sucedera, nem sucederá.
verses.en_web: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shall not happen, neither shall it be.
verses.en_bbe: And you took your robes and made high places for yourself ornamented with every colour, acting like a loose woman on them, without shame or fear.

verses.en: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
verses.pt: Também tomaste as tuas belas jóias feitas do meu ouro e da minha prata que eu te havia dado, e te fizeste imagens de homens, e te prostituíste com elas;
verses.en_web: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.
verses.en_bbe: And you took the fair jewels, my silver and gold which I had given to you, and made for yourself male images, acting like a loose woman with them;

verses.en: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.pt: e tomaste os teus vestidos bordados, e as cobriste; e puseste diante delas o meu azeite e o meu incenso.
verses.en_web: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
verses.en_bbe: And you took your robes of needlework for their clothing, and put my oil and my perfume before them.

verses.en: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: E o meu pão que te dei, a flor de farinha, e o azeite e o mel, com que eu te sustentava, também puseste diante delas em cheiro suave, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And my bread which I gave you, the best meal and oil and honey which I gave you for your food, you put it before them for a sweet smell, says the Lord.

verses.en: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
verses.pt: Além disto, tomaste a teus filhos e tuas filhas, que me geraras, e lhos sacrificaste, para serem devorados pelas chamas. Acaso foi a tua prostituição de tão pouca monta,
verses.en_web: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,
verses.en_bbe: And you took your sons and your daughters whom I had by you, offering even these to them to be their food. Was your loose behaviour so small a thing,

verses.en: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
verses.pt: que havias de matar meus filhos e lhos entregar, fazendo os passar pelo fogo?
verses.en_web: that you have slain my children, and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?
verses.en_bbe: That you put my children to death and gave them up to go through the fire to them?

verses.en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
verses.pt: E em todas as tuas abominações, e nas tuas prostituições, não te lembraste dos dias da tua mocidade, quando tu estavas nua e descoberta, e jazias no teu sangue.
verses.en_web: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.
verses.en_bbe: And in all your disgusting and false behaviour you had no memory of your early days, when you were uncovered and without clothing, stretched out in your blood.

verses.en: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)
verses.pt: E sucedeu, depois de toda a tua maldade (ai, ai de ti! diz o Senhor Deus),
verses.en_web: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness. Woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh,
verses.en_bbe: And it came about, after all your evil-doing, says the Lord,

verses.en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
verses.pt: que te edificaste uma câmara abobadada, e fizeste lugares altos em todas as praças.
verses.en_web: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.
verses.en_bbe: That you made for yourself an arched room in every open place.

verses.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
verses.pt: A cada canto do caminho edificaste o teu lugar alto, e fizeste abominável a tua formosura, e alargaste os teus pés a todo o que passava, e multiplicaste as tuas prostituições.
verses.en_web: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
verses.en_bbe: You put up your high places at the top of every street, and made the grace of your form a disgusting thing, opening your feet to everyone who went by, increasing your loose ways.

verses.en: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.pt: Também te prostituíste com os egípcios, teus vizinbos, grandemente carnais; e multiplicaste a tua prostituição, para me provocares à ira.
verses.en_web: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
verses.en_bbe: And you went with the Egyptians, your neighbours, great of flesh; increasing your loose ways, moving me to wrath.

verses.en: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.pt: Pelo que estendi a minha mão sobre ti, e diminuí a tua porção; e te entreguei à vontade dos que te odeiam, das filhas dos filisteus, as quais se envergonhavam do teu caminho depravado.
verses.en_web: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.
verses.en_bbe: Now, then, my hand is stretched out against you, cutting down your fixed amount, and I have given you up to the desire of your haters, the daughters of the Philistines who are shamed by your loose ways.

verses.en: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
verses.pt: Também te prostituíste com os assírios, porquanto eras insaciável; contudo, prostituindo-te com eles, nem ainda assim ficaste farta.
verses.en_web: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
verses.en_bbe: And you went with the Assyrians, because of your desire which was without measure; you were acting like a loose woman with them, and still you had not enough.

verses.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
verses.pt: Demais multiplicaste as tuas prostituições na terra de tráfico, isto é, até Caldéia, e nem ainda com isso te fartaste.
verses.en_web: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
verses.en_bbe: And you went on in your loose ways, even as far as the land of Chaldaea, and still you had not enough.

verses.en: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.pt: Quão fraco é teu coração, diz o Senhor Deus, fazendo tu todas estas coisas, obra duma meretriz desenfreada,
verses.en_web: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
verses.en_bbe: How feeble is your heart, says the Lord, seeing that you do all these things, the work of a loose and overruling woman;

verses.en: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
verses.pt: edificando a tua câmara abobadada no canto de cada caminho, e fazendo o teu lugar alto em cada rua! Não foste sequer como a meretriz, pois desprezaste a paga;
verses.en_web: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.
verses.en_bbe: For you have made your arched room at the top of every street, and your high place in every open place; though you were not like a loose woman in getting together your payment.

verses.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.pt: tens sido como a mulher adúltera que, em lugar de seu marido, recebe os estranhos.
verses.en_web: “‘“A wife who commits adultery! Who takes strangers instead of her husband!
verses.en_bbe: The untrue wife who takes strange lovers in place of her husband!

verses.en: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
verses.pt: A todas as meretrizes se dá a sua paga, mas tu dás presentes a todos es teus amantes; e lhes dás peitas, para que venham a ti de todas as partes, pelas tuas prostituições.
verses.en_web: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
verses.en_bbe: They give payment to all loose women: but you give rewards to your lovers, offering them payment so that they may come to you on every side for your cheap love.

verses.en: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
verses.pt: Assim és diferente de outras mulheres nas tuas prostituições; pois ninguém te procura para prostituição; pelo contrário tu dás a paga, e não a recebes; assim és diferente.
verses.en_web: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’
verses.en_bbe: And in your loose behaviour you are different from other women, for no one goes after you to make love to you: and because you give payment and no payment is given to you, in this you are different from them.

verses.en: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.pt: Portanto, ó meretriz, ouve a palavra do Senhor.
verses.en_web: “Therefore, prostitute, hear Yahweh’s word:
verses.en_bbe: For this cause, O loose woman, give ear to the voice of the Lord:

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Pois que se derramou a tua lascívia, e se descobriu a tua nudez nas tuas prostituições com os teus amantes; por causa também de todos os ídolos das tuas abominações, e do sangue de teus filhos que lhes deste;
verses.en_web: ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: Because your unclean behaviour was let loose and your body uncovered in your loose ways with your lovers and with your disgusting images, and for the blood of your children which you gave to them;

verses.en: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.pt: portanto eis que ajuntarei todos os teus amantes, com os quais te deleitaste, como também todos os que amaste, juntamente com todos os que odiaste, sim, ajuntá-los-ei contra ti em redor, e descobrirei a tua nudez diante deles, para que vejam toda a tua nudez.
verses.en_web: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those who you have loved, with all those who you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I will get together all your lovers with whom you have taken your pleasure, and all those to whom you have given your love, with all those who were hated by you; I will even make them come together against you on every side, and I will have you uncovered before them so that they may see your shame.

verses.en: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
verses.pt: E julgar-te-ei como são julgadas as adúlteras e as que derramam sangue; e entregar-te-ei ao sangue de furor e de ciúme.
verses.en_web: I will judge you, as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be judged by me as women are judged who have been untrue to their husbands and have taken life; and I will let loose against you passion and bitter feeling.

verses.en: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
verses.pt: Também te entregarei nas mãos dos teus inimigos, e eles derribarão a tua câmara abobadada, e demolirão os teus altos lugares, e te despirão os teus vestidos, e tomarão as tuas belas jóias, e te deixarão nua e descoberta.
verses.en_web: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes, and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you into their hands, and your arched room will be overturned and your high places broken down; they will take your clothing off you and take away your fair jewels: and when they have done, you will be uncovered and shamed.

verses.en: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.pt: Então farão subir uma hoste contra ti, e te apedrejarão, e te traspassarão com as suas espadas.
verses.en_web: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
verses.en_bbe: And they will get together a meeting against you, stoning you with stones and wounding you with their swords.

verses.en: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
verses.pt: E queimarão as tuas casas a fogo, e executarão juízos contra ti, à vista de muitas mulheres; e te farei cessar de ser meretriz, e paga não darás mais.
verses.en_web: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.
verses.en_bbe: And they will have you burned with fire, sending punishments on you before the eyes of great numbers of women; and I will put an end to your loose ways, and you will no longer give payment.

verses.en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.pt: Assim satisfarei em ti o meu furor, e os meus ciúmes se desviarão de ti; também me aquietarei, e não tornarei mais a me indignar.
verses.en_web: So will I cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
verses.en_bbe: And the heat of my wrath against you will have an end, and my bitter feeling will be turned away from you, and I will be quiet and will be angry no longer.

verses.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
verses.pt: Porquanto não te lembraste dos dias da tua mocidade, mas me provocaste à ira com todas estas coisas, eis que eu farei recair o teu caminho sobre a tua cabeça diz o Senhor Deus. Pois não acrescentaste a infidelidade a todas as tuas abominações?
verses.en_web: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.
verses.en_bbe: Because you have not kept in mind the days when you were young, but have been troubling me with all these things; for this reason I will make the punishment of your ways come on your head, says the Lord, because you have done this evil thing in addition to all your disgusting acts.

verses.en: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
verses.pt: Eis que todo o que usa de provérbios usará contra ti deste provérbio: Tal mãe, tal filha.
verses.en_web: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
verses.en_bbe: See, in every common saying about you it will be said, As the mother is, so is her daughter.

verses.en: Thou art thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.pt: Tu és filha de tua mãe, que tinha nojo de seu marido e de seus filhos; e tu és irmã de tuas irmãs, que tinham nojo de seus maridos e de seus filhos. Vossa mãe foi hetéia, e vosso pai amorreu.
verses.en_web: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.en_bbe: You are the daughter of your mother whose soul is turned in disgust from her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters who were turned in disgust from their husbands and their children: your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

verses.en: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.pt: E tua irmã maior, que habita à tua esquerda, é Samária, ela juntamente com suas filhas; e tua irmã menor, que habita à tua mão direita, é Sodoma e suas filhas.
verses.en_web: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
verses.en_bbe: Your older sister is Samaria, living at your left hand, she and her daughters: and your younger sister, living at your right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

verses.en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
verses.pt: Todavia não andaste nos seus caminhos, nem fizeste conforme as suas abominações; mas, como se isso mui pouco fora, ainda te corrompeste mais do que elas, em todos os teus caminhos.
verses.en_web: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
verses.en_bbe: Still you have not gone in their ways or done the disgusting things which they have done; but, as if that was only a little thing, you have gone deeper in evil than they in all your ways.

verses.en: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.pt: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor Deus, não fez Sodoma, tua irmã, nem ela nem suas filhas, como fizeste tu e tuas filhas.
verses.en_web: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
verses.en_bbe: By my life, says the Lord, Sodom your sister never did, she or her daughters, what you and your daughters have done.

verses.en: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.pt: Eis que esta foi a iniqüidade de Sodoma, tua irmã: Soberba, fartura de pão, e próspera ociosidade teve ela e suas filhas; mas nunca fortaleceu a mão do pobre e do necessitado.
verses.en_web: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, this was the sin of your sister Sodom: pride, a full measure of food, and the comforts of wealth in peace, were seen in her and her daughters, and she gave no help to the poor or to those in need.

verses.en: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
verses.pt: Também elas se ensoberbeceram, e fizeram abominação diante de mim; pelo que, ao ver isso, as tirei do seu lugar.
verses.en_web: They were haughty, and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
verses.en_bbe: They were full of pride and did what was disgusting to me: and so I took them away as you have seen.

verses.en: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.pt: Demais Samária não cometeu metade de teus pecados; e multiplicaste as tuas abominações mais do que elas, e justificaste a tuas irmãs, com todas as abominações que fizeste.
verses.en_web: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
verses.en_bbe: And Samaria has not done half your sins; but you have made the number of your disgusting acts greater than theirs, making your sisters seem more upright than you by all the disgusting things which you have done.

verses.en: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.pt: Tu, também, pois que deste sentença favorável a tuas irmãs, leva a tua vergonha; por causa de teus pecados, que fizeste mais abomináveis do que elas, mais justas são elas do que tu; confunde-te logo também, e sofre a tua vergonha, porque justificaste a tuas irmãs.
verses.en_web: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
verses.en_bbe: And you yourself will be put to shame, in that you have given the decision for your sisters; through your sins, which are more disgusting than theirs, they are more upright than you: truly, you will be shamed and made low, for you have made your sisters seem upright.

verses.en: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
verses.pt: Eu, pois, farei tornar do cativeiro a elas, a Sodoma e suas filhas, a Samária e suas filhas, e aos de vós que são cativos no meio delas;
verses.en_web: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;
verses.en_bbe: And I will let their fate be changed, the fate of Sodom and her daughters, and the fate of Samaria and her daughters, and your fate with theirs.

verses.en: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.pt: para que sofras a tua vergonha, e sejas envergonhada por causa de tudo o que fizeste, dando-lhes tu consolação.
verses.en_web: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.
verses.en_bbe: So that you will be shamed and made low because of all you have done, when I have mercy on you.

verses.en: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.pt: Quanto a tuas irmãs, Sodoma e suas filhas, tornarão ao seu primeiro estado; e Samária e suas filhas tornarão ao seu primeiro estado; também tu e tuas filhas tornareis ao vosso primeiro estado.
verses.en_web: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
verses.en_bbe: And your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will go back to their first condition, and Samaria and her daughters will go back to their first condition, and you and your daughters will go back to your first condition.

verses.en: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
verses.pt: Não foi Sodoma, tua irmã, um provérbio na tua boca, no dia da tua soberba,
verses.en_web: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
verses.en_bbe: Was not your sister Sodom an oath in your mouth in the day of your pride,

verses.en: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
verses.pt: antes que fosse descoberta a tua maldade? Agora, de igual modo, te fizeste objeto de opróbrio das filhas da Síria, e de todos os que estão ao redor dela, e para as filhas dos filisteus, que te desprezam em redor.
verses.en_web: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.
verses.en_bbe: Before your shame was uncovered? Now you have become like her a word of shame to the daughters of Edom and all who are round about you, the daughters of the Philistines who put shame on you round about.

verses.en: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Pela tua perversidade e as tuas abominações estás sofrendo, diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: The reward of your evil designs and your disgusting ways has come on you, says the Lord.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.pt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Deus: Eu te farei como fizeste, tu que desprezaste o juramento, quebrantando o pacto.
verses.en_web: “‘For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.en_bbe: For this is what the Lord has said: I will do to you as you have done, you who, putting the oath on one side, have let the agreement be broken.

verses.en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.pt: Contudo eu me lembrarei do meu pacto, que fiz contigo nos dias da tua mocidade; e estabelecerei contigo um pacto eterno.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish to you an everlasting covenant.
verses.en_bbe: But still I will keep in mind the agreement made with you in the days when you were young, and I will make with you an eternal agreement.

verses.en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.pt: Então te lembrarás dos teus caminhos, e ficarás envergonhada, quando receberes tuas irmãs, as mais velhas e as mais novas, e eu tas der por filhas, mas não por causa do pacto contigo.
verses.en_web: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
verses.en_bbe: Then at the memory of your ways you will be overcome with shame, when I take your sisters, the older and the younger, and give them to you for daughters, but not by your agreement.

verses.en: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD:
verses.pt: E estabelecerei o meu pacto contigo, e saberás que eu sou o Senhor;
verses.en_web: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;
verses.en_bbe: And I will make my agreement with you; and you will be certain that I am the Lord:

verses.en: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: para que te lembres, e te envergonhes, e nunca mais abras a tua boca, por causa da tua vergonha, quando eu te perdoar tudo quanto fizeste, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more, because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
verses.en_bbe: So that, at the memory of these things, you may be at a loss, never opening your mouth because of your shame; when you have my forgiveness for all you have done, says the Lord.
